entries.purpose: Run a build, test or other expensive command under the box-wide heavy slot so jobs don't overload the machine: append the command and its arguments after heavy, as separate words
entries.output: the command's own output and exit code; heavy waits for a free slot first
entries.stop: ends when the command ends; heavy --light <command> skips the box-wide slot, heavy --expensive <command> forces it

entries.purpose: Show whether the Sindri control plane is running and its summary
entries.output: one summary; --json for one object; exit 1 when it isn't running

entries.purpose: Run Sindri's health checks: lease, ledger, views, profile, api, temporal and context
entries.output: one ok, warn or fail line per check with its fix; --json for one object
entries.stop: exits at once; runs without the control plane

entries.purpose: List every live agent session on the box (provider, state, repo)
entries.output: one line per session; --json for one object; --provider, --state and --repo filter
entries.stop: exits at once; never starts the control plane

entries.purpose: Show what the meta session owes, the merge queue, the owner queue and the lane map
entries.output: the status text; --json for one object; exit 1 while anything is owed

entries.purpose: Check the meta team's box: memory, disk, lane sessions and orphaned processes
entries.output: HEALTH OK or HEALTH ATTENTION and one line per finding; --json for one object; exit 1 on attention
entries.stop: exits at once; records its summary for aw-meta status; --kill-orphans also stops orphaned processes

entries.purpose: Wait for the next team event (mail, a merge, a stalled lane) and print it, instead of writing a polling loop
entries.output: one line per event; --json for objects
entries.stop: exits on the first event; --for <dur> bounds the wait (for example 29m); --interval <s> sets the poll
